project.name: Archic Website
project.sector: digital systems, web and custom software studio

direction.justification: Owner-approved 2026-11 concepts: editorial light surface (#F8F9FB / white / ink #101217) with Archic blue #075BCD as a precise accent. Typography carries authority; real portfolio imagery and one licensed sky photograph give atmosphere; Weather proves product craft with real data.
direction.archetypeRepeatJustification: This is Archic's own production site. Cinematic Sequence and Editorial Spread are selected because the approved visual reference relies on art-directed imagery, strong serif hierarchy, portfolio scenes and quiet editorial rhythm rather than technical dashboards.

exceptions.reason: The repository does not contain enough source and licence evidence for the legacy JPG and WebP sets. They remain outside the active production graph.
V3 uses named Unsplash License images as non-client art-direction material and clearly avoids presenting representative yacht photography as actual fleet inventory.
Rise DHMN, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0; cropped and re-encoded as local WebP; credited on every page that shows it.
